ConnectedCalendar.title: Connected Calendar
ConnectedCalendar.description: Represents a synchronization hook for a third-party calendar system

provider.description: Provider key (e.g. google, apple, outlook, yahoo, other)

name.description: Human readable title of provider system

emailOrUrl.description: Account email address or endpoint sync URL

CalendarEvent.title: Normalized Calendar Event
CalendarEvent.description: Secure normalized event summary used for economic indicator overlapping

id.description: Source unique identifier or random key

calendarId.description: Link to parent connected calendar record

ApiHealthLog.title: API Health Monitor Log
ApiHealthLog.description: Records status metrics, latency times, and handshake logs for third-party clearpath APIs

api_name.description: The exact name of the monitored public or third-party service

response_time.description: Response time latency calculation in milliseconds

message.description: Returned debug code or diagnostic trace logs

checked_at.description: ServerTimestamp of safety check cycle execution

GlobeCountryConfig.title: Global Rollout Country Configuration
GlobeCountryConfig.description: Firestore-driven rollout nodes settings managed by the CEO containing launch waves, statuses, coloring, and signup telemetry

id.description: Assigned country ISO3 code or customized identity string

countryName.description: Standard display title of the target country

launchPhase.description: Launch phase tag (e.g. Stage 1: Active Mainframe, Stage 2: Sandbox Warmup)

highlightEnabled.description: Flag configuration to trigger highlighting and glowing overlays

SyncedForm.title: Synced Google Form
SyncedForm.description: Represents a Google Form configuration synchronized with Firestore

userId.description: Pointer to the owner account uid

FormResponse.title: Synced Form Response
FormResponse.description: Represents a response/submission for a synced Google Form, stored in Firestore

formId.description: Link to parent synced form ID

userId.description: Pointer to the owner account uid

CpmsVideo.title: CPMS Streaming Video Metadata
CpmsVideo.description: Stores user and system uploaded video media, channels, metadata on CPMS APK screen

videoUrl.description: Remote public or Storage stream path link

relatedIndicatorId.description: Optional matched indicator code in the Encyclopedia

CpmsChannel.title: CPMS Custom Channel
CpmsChannel.description: Represents custom dynamic television channels created inside CPMS Channel Manager

id.description: Unique format id for the custom channel

name.description: The name or category text of the channel

thumbnailUrl.description: Channel thumbnail image link or generic neon gradient styling

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when channel was setup

createdBy.description: Founder email index who made this entry

/cpms_channels/{channelId}.description: Collection of dynamic television channels managed by CPMS Channel Manager

/cpms_videos/{videoId}.description: CPMS video contents, categories, and indicator bindings

/users/{userId}/synced_forms/{formId}.description: User Google Forms connected and tracked in Firestore

/users/{userId}/synced_forms/{formId}/re.description: User Google Form responses synced and archived in Firestore

/api_health_logs/{logId}.description: Stored API connection trace logs and diagnostic indicators

/globe_country_configs/{configId}.description: CEO managed real-time Global wave coordinates and dynamic country configurations
